title: LEGS & BALANCE
subtitle: MONDAY EASE. LIGHT LEGS. SOFT BALANCE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Monday is light legs and soft balance — a small break from the desk, nothing fierce. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Light legs, a bit of balance, and you showed up. Enjoy your day — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Lift one knee gently, then lower with control. Alternate sides. Soft ankle, soft hip — only a comfortable height. Smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of eight per leg. Sit tall, soft belly, lift one knee gently, lower with control. Alternate. Keep it easy.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Stay seated. Soften the hips.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward only as far as feels kind, then sit back up with control. Soft on the low back and the backs of the legs. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two sets of six. Sit tall, hinge softly from the hips, reach forward only as far as feels kind, then sit back up. Easy on the back.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: CHAIR SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft hands on the armrests or thighs. Lean a little forward and stand up only as high as feels kind, then sit back down with control. Shallow is perfect. No bounce. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair sit to stand. Two sets of five. Soft hands on the chair, lean a little forward, stand only as high as feels kind, then sit back down. Keep it shallow and easy.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Shake the legs. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stands done. Well done.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light hand on the backrest. Softly shift weight onto one foot and lift the other heel or foot a little. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch. Use the chair as much as you need. Eyes soft, easy breath. Smaller hold is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two sets of about twenty seconds each side. Light hand on the chair, soft weight on one foot, lift the other a little. Use the chair as much as you need.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Shake it out. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session — lovely work.
